_comment: EXAMPLE (not the live path): OpenAI FIRST-PARTY inference provider target. Use this when one end of your migration is a model on api.openai.com. The API key is NOT stored here — it goes in an AgentCore API_KEY credential provider in the token vault (setup_gateway.py reads OPENAI_API_KEY and creates it, then injects providerArn here). To use: set SOURCE_MODEL = mc.EXAMPLE_SOURCE_OPENAI_1P and provision this target. Replace ACCOUNT_ID or let setup_gateway.py resolve it.
name: openai
